# Bihar Maize Bulk Buyer Report — 20 May 2026 (Budhwar)
## Warehouse Arbitrage & Storage Profit Strategy

### AAJ KA SONA: BULK KHAREEDARON KE LIYE PERFECT ENTRY WINDOW KHUL GAYI HAI

Bulk trader bhai, aaj ka din ek bada mauka leke aaya hai. Har ek factor aaj bulk kharidari ki taraf point kar raha hai:

**Situation Analysis:**
Rabi arrivals tapering phase mein hain — mandi mein maal khatam ho raha hai. Aaj spot price ₹1,950 par hai. NCDEX futures ₹2,014 par hain — ₹64 ka instant arbitrage gap. China ne America se $17B ka ag deal kiya — global corn prices ₹4.7% uchhal gaye. BIS ne E30 fuel standards tay kiye — ethanol maang badhti rahegi. Crude oil $110+ — distilleries ka kaam band nahi hoga.

**Warehouse Strategy in Detail:**
Bihar aur UP mein CWC (Central Warehousing Corporation) ke registered warehouses mein ₹15-20/quintal/month mein dry grain storage milti hai. Purnea, Muzaffarpur, Samastipur — yahan se WDRA-registered private warehouses bhi available hain ₹20-25/quintal/month mein. Maize ke liye moisture 12-14% rakhna zaroori hai — agar zyada nami hai toh pehle dry karo ₹5-8/quintal mein.

**Profit Calculator:**
- 1,000 quintal kharidne par aaj: ₹19,50,000 investment (₹1,950×1,000)
- 3-mahine warehouse cost: ₹1,09,000 (₹109×1,000)
- August mein ₹2,100 par becho: ₹21,00,000
- NET PROFIT: ₹41,000 (₹41×1,000 quintal) — 2.1% return in 3 months
- 4-mahine hold karke September mein ₹2,150 par becho: NET PROFIT ₹73,000
- 8-mahine hold karke January 2027 mein ₹2,300 par becho: NET PROFIT ₹1,51,000 (7.7% return)

**WDRA Warehouse Receipt Financing:**
Yeh sabse important tool hai bulk traders ke liye. WDRA-registered warehouse mein maal rakho, warehouse receipt lo, bank ko dikhao — bank 70-80% value ka loan deta hai. Matlab 1,000 quintal ke liye ₹19.5 lakh ka maal, sirf ₹4-5 lakh apna lagao — baaki ₹14-15 lakh bank loan. Effective leverage 3-4x!

**Key Risks to Watch:**
1. Kharif arrivals October-November — daam temporarily dab sakta hai
2. Moisture damage — maize moisture 14% se zyada ho toh fungus/mold
3. Iran deal — agar tel sasta hua toh ethanol ki urgency thodi kam
4. FSSAI DDGS clearance — agar aayi toh poultry ka maize demand thoda kam
5. Capital cost — bank loan interest 8-10% p.a. — isko profit se minus karo

**Sabse Accha Strategy:**
Aaj 40% stock khareed lo immediately. Baaki 30% June ke first week mein khareedna jab rabi season almost khatam ho jaayega. Final 30% Juy-August mein khareedna jab kharif planting worries shuru hongi. Stage karke becho: August-September 40%, December-January 60%.

market_sentiment.text: Bulk buyers ke liye aaj ka din 'strongly bullish' hai — perfect storm of entry conditions. Seasonal low daam (rabi tapering), NCDEX ₹64 arbitrage gap, global shortages, China demand push, E30 policy support — yeh sab ek saath aa gaye hain. Jab yeh saari conditions ek saath milti hain toh bulk warehouse arbitrage ka sahi entry window hota hai.
market_sentiment.summary: 20 May 2026 — Purnea spot ₹1,950 par hai. Bulk buyers ke liye yeh 5 badi cheezein ek saath acchi hain: (1) NCDEX June futures ₹2,014 — ₹64 instant arbitrage gap; (2) China-US $17B deal se CBOT 4.7% uchhal gaya — import parity badhegi; (3) BIS E30 standard — distillery demand permanent aur badhega; (4) Global stocks 277.5 MMT — 13-year low — global support; (5) Rabi arrivals tapering — yeh mausami low ka last window hai. Warehouse strategy: aaj ₹1,950 mein khareed — 3-4 mahine baad August-September lean season mein ₹2,100-2,150 mein becho — net profit ₹50-75/quintal after all costs. Ya 8 mahine hold karo January 2027 tak ₹2,300 target ke saath — net profit ₹150/quintal.

bulk_buyer_confidence_factors.seasonal_timing: Rabi tapering = seasonal low = IDEAL ENTRY (9/10)
bulk_buyer_confidence_factors.global_support: China deal + global shortage = price support (8/10)
bulk_buyer_confidence_factors.financing_available: WDRA warehouse receipt loans = low capital needed (8/10)

predictions_10_day.trend_text: Din 1 (20 May) — Aaj BUY KARO! ₹1,950 rabi season ka floor price hai. NCDEX ₹2,014 bol raha hai daam badhenge. BULK BUYER ACTION: Abhi 30-40% quantity khareed lo aaj hi. Purnea, Gulabbagh mandis mein jaao — bulk deal mein thoda negotiation possible (₹5-10 discount per quintal agar 100+ quintal ekhaath khareed rahe ho). CWC warehouse booking bhi aaj karo advance mein.

Din 2 (21 May) — Daam ₹5 badhkar ₹1,955 — lekin abhi bhi GOOD ENTRY. Kal bhi khareedo agar aaj nahi khareed paye. China deal ka asar dheere dheere Bihar mandi mein aata hai. BULK BUYER ACTION: Kal ka ₹1,955 bhi theek hai — abhi bhi ₹59 ka NCDEX arbitrage gap baki hai. Second tranche khareedne ka time.

Din 3 (22 May) — ₹1,960 par. NCDEX arbitrage gap ab ₹54 ka raha. BULK BUYER ACTION: Agar warehouse booking confirm ho gayi hai toh shukravar ko bhi khareed sakte ho. Lekin agar volume bahut bada hai (1,000+ quintal) toh transport logistics plan karo pehle — ek hi din mein sab nahi hoga.

Din 4 (23 May, Saturday) — ₹1,963 par. Saturday ko mandi thodi dheemi. BULK BUYER ACTION: Saturday ko mandi mein fewer sellers — negotiation power thodi better. Agar Friday tak nahi khareed paye toh Saturday bhi option hai.

Din 5 (24 May, Sunday) — MANDI BAND. BULK BUYER ACTION: Sunday ko warehouse audit karo — kitni capacity available hai, moisture-control theek hai, fumigation schedule plan karo. Agle hafte ke liye transport bookings confirm karo. Distillery buyers ko call karo forward deal ke baare mein baat karo.

Din 6 (25 May, Monday) — ₹1,968 par. BULK BUYER ACTION: Monday fresh week — nayi deals possible. Agar aaj tak poora target quantity nahi khareed paye ho, toh Monday is aakhiri comfortable entry day hai. ₹1,968 par bhi ₹46 ka NCDEX gap hai — profitable holding still confirmed.

Din 7 (26 May) — ₹1,971 par. BULK BUYER ACTION: Last tranche khareed lo agar baaki hai. ₹1,971 par buy price → NCDEX ₹2,014 → still ₹43 gap → minus ₹109 storage cost → break-even ₹2,080 → August target ₹2,100 → net profit ₹20/quintal minimum. Slim margin but still positive.

Din 8 (27 May) — ₹1,974 par. BULK BUYER ACTION: Agar ₹1,974 par khareed rahe ho toh break-even ₹2,083 ho jaata hai — lean season premium ₹2,100-2,150 se profit ₹17-67/quintal — thin margin. Is din ke baad khareedna risky hone lagta hai jab tak September-October ka longer hold nahi karna.

Din 9 (28 May) — ₹1,976 par. BULK BUYER ACTION: Agar pehle se khareed rakha hai — HOLD KARO. Naya khareedna ₹1,976 par sirf tab sahi hai agar aap September-January hold karne ka patience rakho. Short-term (3-month) profit squeeze hone laga is price par.

Din 10 (29 May) — ₹1,976 stable. BULK BUYER SUMMARY: 10-din ka ideal buying window aaj se shuru hoke 25-26 May tak hai. Best entry price ₹1,950-1,968. Iske baad hold strategy shift ho jaati hai: already-purchased stock warehoused karo, monitor karo, August-September mein sell karo. EXPECTED 3-MONTH RETURN: 2-4% net after costs. EXPECTED 8-MONTH RETURN: 7-8% net after costs.

sell_milestones.reasoning: Lean season peak — mandi mein kharif abhi nahi aaya — distillery demand high — August-September sabse accha selling window rabi vs kharif ke beech. ₹2,100 conservative target. ₹2,150 optimistic.

Post-kharif arrivals peak ke baad daam recover karta hai. October-November mein daam dab sakta hai kharif arrivals se — patience rakho. December mein ₹2,200 target realistic. RISK: Agar kharif bumper crop aayi toh daam dabe rahe — jaldi becho phir.

Rabi sowing complete, kharif stored maal khatam — next rabi arrivals March mein — January-February sabse zyada lean season. Historically makka ka highest price is window mein milta hai. ₹2,300 ambitious lekin possible agar global conditions support rakhen.

buyers.action_text: ABHI KHAREED LO — Aaj 40% quantity ₹1,950-1,960 mein, Agle 3-5 din mein 35% aur, Last 25% June first week mein ₹1,970-1,975 tak
buyers.reason: Perfect entry window: NCDEX ₹64 arbitrage gap, rabi tapering, global shortage, China demand, E30 mandate, distillery demand. Yeh sab factors ek saath aaye hain — is window ko miss mat karo. Agle 10-15 din mein entry price badhegi.
buyers.advice:
STEP 1 — SOURCING: Purnea (Gulabbagh), Begusarai, Samastipur mandis se bulk khareed karo. 100+ quintal ek saath ek seller se khareedne par ₹5-10/quintal negotiation karo. Moisture check zaroori hai — 12-14% se zyada mat lo.

STEP 2 — WAREHOUSE: CWC registered warehouse book karo advance mein — ₹15-20/quintal/month. WDRA-registered warehouse lete ho toh bank loan bhi milega 70-80% value par. Fumigation aur moisture monitoring schedule set karo.

STEP 3 — FINANCING: WDRA warehouse receipt financing use karo — bank se 70-75% value ka loan lo ₹8.5-9% interest par. ₹1,950/quintal ke stock par ₹1,365-1,560/quintal loan milega — effective apna capital sirf ₹390-585/quintal lagana padega.

STEP 4 — SELL PLANNING: August-September mein 40% becho ₹2,100 target. December mein 35% becho ₹2,200 target. January-February 2027 mein 25% becho ₹2,300 target. Weighted average sell price: ~₹2,165. All-in cost: ~₹1,950 + ₹150 warehouse/financing = ₹2,100. Net profit: ~₹65-215/quintal depending on exit timing.

bulk_quantity_recommendations.small_trader_100_500_quintal: Purnea ya Begusarai ek mandi se khareed. Private warehouse adequate. Capital ₹1.9L-9.75L needed (with WDRA financing ₹55K-2.9L effective).
bulk_quantity_recommendations.medium_trader_500_2000_quintal: 3-4 mandis se source karo diverse karo. CWC warehouse prefer karo — better infrastructure. WDRA financing jaroor karo. Advance distillery deals start karo.
bulk_quantity_recommendations.large_trader_2000plus_quintal: Multi-mandi sourcing strategy. Dedicated warehouse infrastructure invest karo. Futures market par partial hedge bhi lo. Distillery aur poultry ke saath advance MOUs sign karo.

sellers.action_text: HOLD KARO — Agar aapke paas pehle se maize stock hai toh ABHI MAT BECHO — agle 3-6 mahine mein zyada daam milega
sellers.reason: Agar aapke paas already warehouse stock hai: NCDEX ₹2,014 ka target hai, China deal bullish hai, E30 policy support hai, lean season aane wali hai. Aaj ₹1,950 mein bechna suboptimal hoga — August-September mein ₹2,100+ milega aur storage cost sirf ₹109/quintal hai.
sellers.advice:
Agar stock July 2026 tak rakhne ki capacity hai: HOLD KARO. Break-even ₹2,059 hai 3-mahine hold ke baad. August mein ₹2,100 milna realistic hai. Net profit ₹41/quintal guaranteed nahi hai lekin probability high hai.

Exceptions — Abhi becho agar: (1) Cash flow emergency hai, (2) Warehouse mein moisture problem hai, (3) FSSAI ne DDGS clearance de di — toh poultry demand loss hoga so quickly becho, (4) Iran deal hua aur crude sasta gaya — ethanol urgency kam hogi.
sellers.alternative: Agar rakhne ki jagah nahi hai ya cash chahiye abhi toh aaj ₹1,950 mein becho. Yeh daam bhi April ke ₹1,912 se ₹38 zyada hai — reasonable return hai. NCDEX Strong Buy signal hai lekin guaranteed nahi — koi bhi market prediction 100% nahi hoti.

bearish: KHARIF ARRIVALS RISK (October-November 2026): Yeh sabse bada risk hai bulk warehouse strategy ke liye. October-November mein kharif makka ki nayi fasal aati hai — mandis mein zyada maal = daam temporary dab sakta hai ₹100-150/quintal. Agar aapne September tak nahi becha aur October mein fasal aai toh nuksan ho sakta hai. MITIGATION: September ke pehle 40-50% bech do. Baaki 50% post-kharif lean season (January) ke liye rakhna zyada accha hai.

STORAGE QUALITY RISK: Maize ek sensitive grain hai — moisture, fungi/mold, pests. Agar warehouse mein 14%+ moisture hai ya fumigation proper nahi ki toh quality kharab ho sakti hai. Quality kharab = discount mein bechna padega. Bihar mein garmi + baarish = extra vigilance zaroori. MITIGATION: WDRA-registered warehouse le, weekly moisture check karo, proper fumigation schedule rakhna. Insurance zaroor lo.

FSSAI DDGS GM CLEARANCE: Agar Food Safety Authority ne American DDGS (genetically modified makka se bana sasta poultry feed) ko clearance de di, toh poultry segment makka ki jagah DDGS khareedna shuru kar dega. Poultry sector India ka makka ka 30-35% consumer hai — agar yeh demand giri toh daam ₹50-100 neeche aa sakta hai. MITIGATION: Distillery buyers focus karo — unke liye DDGS substitute nahi hai. Poultry exposure avoid karo.

FINANCING COST: Agar WDRA loan le rahe ho toh bank interest 8.5-9% per annum = ₹13-14/quintal/month. 6 mahine ke liye ₹78-84/quintal interest extra. Yeh storage cost mein add hota hai — net profit calculator mein zaroor include karo. Agar interest rates bhadhe toh profit margin squeeze ho sakta hai.

IRAN DEAL RISK: Agar Trump-Iran negotiations successful rahe aur Strait of Hormuz khuli toh crude oil $80-90 par aa sakta hai. Sasta tel = ethanol ki urgency kam = distilleries ki demand thodi slack ho sakti hai. ₹20-30/quintal ka downward pressure possible. MITIGATION: Is risk ke baare mein inform raho — news track karo aur agar deal close ho rahi ho toh jaldi becho.
bullish: SEASONAL ARBITRAGE MATH WORKS: Rabi season ka floor price ₹1,950 abhi hai. Historical pattern: lean season (July-September) mein ₹150-200/quintal ka premium milta hai. Warehouse cost ₹109/quintal 3 mahine mein. Net spread = ₹41-91/quintal. Yeh math consistently work karta hai har saal jab global conditions normal hon. Aaj conditions bahut acchi hain — China deal, global shortage, ethanol demand — sab ek saath.

NCDEX ARBITRAGE CONFIRMED: NCDEX June 2026 futures ₹2,014 par hai — spot ₹1,950 se ₹64 upar. NCDEX May contract ₹2,032 par expire hua. Futures market bol raha hai daam ₹2,014+ jaayega — yeh professional traders ka collective judgment hai. Spot-to-futures basis arbitrage ek well-established strategy hai commodity markets mein.

GLOBAL SHORTAGE = IMPORT PARITY PROTECTION: USDA confirms global stocks 277.5 MMT — 2013 ke baad sabse kam. CBOT corn $4.70/bushel + 5% import duty + freight = India mein imported corn ₹2,300-2,500 landed. Aapka domestic ₹2,100-2,200 SASTA dikhega buyers ko. Global shortage ensures aapka stock kabhi zero value mein nahi jaata.

CHINA DEAL STRUCTURAL IMPACT: $17 billion annual agricultural purchase for 3 years (2026-2028). Yeh ek recurring demand factor hai — 2026 mein jo global corn tightness aayi hai, woh 2027 mein bhi rahegi. Matlab aapki warehouse strategy sirf ek saal ki nahi hai — yeh ek multi-year recurring opportunity ban sakti hai.

WDRA LEVERAGE AMPLIFIES RETURNS: WDRA warehouse receipt financing se effective return amplify hota hai. Example: ₹5 lakh apna lagao, ₹15 lakh bank loan lo — total ₹20 lakh ka stock (1,025 quintal). 8 mahine baad net profit ₹1,51,000 (₹151 × 1,000 quintal) minus interest ₹90,000 = ₹61,000 net on ₹5 lakh capital = 12.2% return on own capital. Leverage kaam ka hai!

DISTILLERY SECTOR = ASSURED EXIT: India mein 300+ ethanol distilleries chal rahi hain. E20 mandatory hai already. E30 ka rasta BIS ne open kar diya. Distilleries ko HAMESHA MAKKA CHAHIYE. Yeh aapka guaranteed buyer base hai — poultry ya starch industry se zyada reliable. Advance deals possible hain — 3-4 mahine pehle hi ₹2,100 lock kar sakte ho.
neutral: CURRENCY (INR/USD ₹96.44): Kamzor rupaya = import mehnga = domestic stock valuable (bulk buyer ke liye accha). Lekin kamzor rupaya = overall inflation = buyers ke paas bhi thoda cash pressure. Net impact: slightly positive for warehouse holders but not a major factor.

JUNE 11 USDA WASDE: Agli report mein Brazil estimate update hogi. CONAB 139.6 MMT bol rahi hai jabki USDA 135 MMT. Agar USDA ne Brazil estimate badhaya toh global stocks zyada dikhenge — thoda bearish. Lekin China deal ki wajah se demand bhi badhi hai — net neutral to slightly bullish expected.
WEATHER: Bihar mein heatwave aur possible thunderstorm — logistics planning affect ho sakta hai. Long-term bulk strategy par koi impact nahi — sirf transport scheduling adjust karo.

metadata.key_difference_from_farmer_report: Is report mein farmer ki jagah bulk trader/investor ka perspective hai. Recommendations storage arbitrage strategy par focused hain — buy at seasonal lows, warehouse, sell at lean season premium. Profit calculations include warehouse cost, insurance, fumigation, transport, and WDRA financing costs.
metadata.rabi_arrival_status: tapering — last 2-3 weeks of buying window
metadata.key_risks_to_watch: 4 badi risks bulk buyers ke liye: (1) Kharif arrivals October-November — daam temporarily dab sakta hai — September ke pehle 40% becho; (2) FSSAI DDGS GM clearance — poultry maize demand loss risk; (3) Iran deal — crude sasta = ethanol urgency kam; (4) Storage quality/moisture — WDRA warehouse prefer karo aur weekly monitoring karo.
metadata.warehouse_strategy_tip: WDRA registered warehouse mandatory lo — sirf isme bank loan milega. CWC ya state warehouses sabse reliable hain Bihar mein. Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga, Purnea mein multiple options available hain.
metadata.description: 20 May 2026 (Budhwar) — BULK BUYER WAREHOUSE ARBITRAGE REPORT. Purnea spot ₹1,950 — NCDEX June futures ₹2,014 (₹64 gap). Rabi arrivals tapering — last buying window open. China $17B ag deal, BIS E30 standards, global stocks 277.5 MMT all support higher prices ahead. Buy at ₹1,950-1,970 today. Target sell August-September ₹2,100 (net profit ₹41/quintal). Target sell January 2027 ₹2,300 (net profit ₹151/quintal). WDRA financing amplifies returns 3-4x.
